|-----|------|------|---------|-------------|-----------|----------------|

| **PWV2** | Tiny Preview | .DAT | 100 (fixed) | 1 | ~0.33 Hz for full track | 4-bit height only |
| **PWV3** | Waveform Detail | .EXT | Variable (150/sec) | 1 | 150 entries/second | 5-bit height, 3-bit whiteness (blue) |
| **PWV4** | Color Waveform Preview | .EXT | 1,200 (fixed) | 6 | ~4 Hz for full track | RGB (7-bit channels) + luminance + blue dual-layer |
| **PWV5** | Color Waveform Detail | .EXT | Variable (150/sec) | 2 | 150 entries/second | 3-bit RGB (8 levels each) + 5-bit height |
| **PWV6** | 3-Band Preview | .2EX | 1,200 (fixed) | 3 | ~4 Hz for full track | 3 bytes: mid, high, low frequency heights |
| **PWV7** | 3-Band Detail | .2EX | Variable (150/sec) | 3 | 150 entries/second | 3 bytes: mid, high, low frequency heights |
| **PWVC** | Color Configuration (undocumented) | .2EX | N/A | N/A | N/A | Unknown purpose |

**Hardware Coverage:**
- PWAV/PWV2: All Pioneer DJ hardware (CDJ-900+)
- PWV3: NXS+ era and newer
- PWV4/PWV5: NXS2+ (CDJ-2000NXS2, CDJ-3000, XDJ-XZ)

```python
wf_color       = anlz.get("wf_color")          # PWV4

tag7 = anlz.get_tag("PWV7")
```

```python
# col_color: np.ndarray[int64], shape (1200, 2, 3) — [base_rgb, bright_rgb]
```
